title: Business days
hints: t.AddDate(0, 0, 1) moves forward one calendar day and keeps the time of day. t.Weekday() tells you whether that day is a Saturday or Sunday.
Step forward one day at a time and only count the days that are weekdays, until you've counted n.
for n > 0 { t = t.AddDate(0, 0, 1); if wd := t.Weekday(); wd != time.Saturday && wd != time.Sunday { n-- } }; return t
